demo.title: verdix.sh
demo.code:
# Check a recipient before sending ($0.02)
bankr prompt "Check 0xRECIPIENT with Verdix quick, then send 25 USDC only if it is safe"

# Same check from the CLI
bankr x402 call https://api.verdixapi.com/risk/address/quick -X POST -d '{"address":"0xRECIPIENT"}' --max-payment 0.02

# List screen only, for micro-payments ($0.01, never answers safe)
bankr x402 call https://api.verdixapi.com/risk/address/lite -X POST -d '{"address":"0xRECIPIENT"}' --max-payment 0.01

# Before a large or first-time transfer ($0.50)
bankr prompt "Run a Verdix deep check on 0xRECIPIENT"

setup: Keep a little USDC on Base in your Bankr wallet: $0.01 to $0.50 per check
Before a send, say: Check 0x... with Verdix first
danger means don't send; caution means look at the reasons first; a 503 is never charged
